name: Chambéry Savoie Mont Blanc (Chambéry-Aix-les-Bains)

runway.v: one paved runway, 18/36, 2,020 m long and 45 m wide (plus a 700 m grass strip)

slots.v: IATA Level 2; operators ask their handling agent to request slots from COHOR; for IFR general and business aviation a prior request is required
slots.quote: Aircraft operators contact their handling agent who is in charge to request airport slots to COHOR.

hours.v: hours of operation 07:00-20:59 local (slot coordinator's airport page)

handling.v: business terminal open December to April 07:30-21:00 local (Fridays to 22:00); 1 May to December closed, open on request. The airport's own opening-hours page gives different business terminal times, so confirm before planning
handling.quote: December to april (local time): Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday: 07:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. ... Friday: 07:30 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. ... 1st of May to December: Closed. Open on request

notes: All AIP facts from AIP France AD 2 LFLB (AIRAC AMDT 04/25, 17 APR 2025) as republished by DIRCAM; the current SIA edition could not be opened, so changes since April 2025 are possible. ATS hours are in UTC; the French AIP convention is one hour earlier in summer, giving 08:00-21:00 local, but that convention line was not quoted for this page. No explicit night closure is stated. Stands are limited by wingspan and length (largest stands Z1/Z3: 21 m by 30 m), not by weight. COHOR facilitation applies mid-December to mid-April (winter season).
